description: [distrust-audit] bin/selfimprove-monitor.sh writes OK|FAIL to ~/vault/selfimprove/monitor.log and comments claim 'the FAIL line IS the alert' — but no consumer found (grep of arc-webui/arc-agents ts sources: zero references). A FAIL morning is silent unless a human tails the file. Wire monitor.log into a surfaced dashboard/notification or the alert is fiction.

[distrust-audit] nightly-self-improve.sh: dream/token-waste/gap-remediate adaptors write with --permission-mode acceptEdits, and the safety net (adaptation-review + regression-reviewer, SKILL.md:91) is report-only — findings land in the journal with no gate, rollback, or escalation path, so a confirmed-bad adaptation persists until a human happens to read the journal. Add a loud path: regression flag → open feedback entry / revert PR, not prose.

author: aaron
description: Bloat + zero-dependency doubt: 91 skills may be past curation capacity, and the zero-dependency charter may not be maintainable. KE, pipeliner, and cli-agent are CORE to the workspace — keeping arc-skills strictly independent of them could be crippling agents. Reconsider: allow first-party core deps (ke/pipeliner/cli-agent) as sanctioned integration points rather than forbidden.
